verdict.rationale: OneDrive can be driven programmatically without the desktop UI through Microsoft Graph. The pack documents the building blocks automation needs: path- and ID-based item addressing, single-call and resumable uploads, delta change tracking, change notifications, search, and sharing-link creation. However, there is no evidence that it runs headless in a CI context specifically. Missing for 10: an official CLI or headless client, documented non-interactive/app-only authentication for unattended CI jobs, CI integration examples, and independent or hands-on corroboration of automated use.
